chains.name: Unblock the Dell invoice
chains.desc: Turns a blocked SAP invoice into a signed-price reconciliation, corrected-invoice request and closed task — no swivel chair

steps.result: Invoice 5601-88274 · $214,380 blocked, unit price 4.1% over contract
Amendment 3 (env DS-4471) · FY27 pricing on 14 Latitude SKUs extracted
Corrected invoice requested — msg OUT-20818, Aug 15 deadline set
PRC-1035 update posted ahead of the 14:30 Dell QBR — Diego and Anna tagged

chains.outcome: Dell's $8,790 overcharge was proven against DocuSign Amendment 3, a corrected invoice was requested in Outlook with an Aug 15 deadline, the reconciliation lives in Excel, and PRC-1035 is updated in Teams before the QBR.

insight.headline: 3 of Dell's last 96 POs invoiced above signed pricing — $8,790 caught this quarter
insight.detail: Joining SAP's blocked-invoice detail with the SKU pricing signed in DocuSign Amendment 3 and the PO history in Ariba shows the mismatch is a pattern on Latitude SKUs, not a one-off keying error. SAP only sees a block, DocuSign only sees a signature, Ariba only sees a PO — no single system can compare invoiced price to contracted price.
insight.action: Add an auto-check that validates every Dell invoice against Amendment 3 pricing before posting

chains.name: Ship the Adobe renewal
chains.desc: Takes the agreed redlines to a signed-ready envelope, a booked PO and a notified team before the Aug 31 expiry

steps.result: v4 redlines pulled — liability cap at 12 months fees agreed per Sarah Kim
228 seats confirmed post-audit (12 trimmed) · $82,080 at 3% uplift
Envelope DS-5203 sent for signature — Katie O'Brien cc'd, expires Aug 31
PO-78240 created for $82,080, linked to envelope DS-5203
Signature status posted — PRC-1038 marked done, Anna and Katie notified

chains.outcome: The Adobe renewal went from redlines in SharePoint to envelope DS-5203 in DocuSign and PO-78240 in Ariba, with #sourcing-saas notified and PRC-1038 closed — 23 days before the Aug 31 expiry.

insight.headline: The 12-seat license audit saved $4,320/yr — offsetting 105% of Adobe's 3% uplift
insight.detail: Only by joining Excel's post-audit seat count with DocuSign's uplift terms and SAP's FY25 invoice baseline does the net cost land flat year-over-year. DocuSign shows a 3% price increase and Excel shows fewer seats, but neither alone reveals that the trim fully cancels the uplift.
insight.action: Run the same license audit on Okta's 2,400 seats before Mei-Ling sends the $288K counter
